name: Hari Mess
signature_dish: Chicken fry and mutton fry on a banana leaf
why_it_matters: Kotagiri's best-known non-veg mess — a small, clean, family-run eatery on the main road serving homemade Tamil/Kongu meat dishes on banana leaf at honest prices. In a town with very few sit-down restaurants, this is the address locals send visitors to for chicken fry and mutton fry.
insider_tip: No-frills and limited menu — order the chicken fry or mutton fry with rice meals. Lunch is the main service; come early before the daily batches run out. Cash-friendly.
signature_address: Hari Mess, Main Road, Kotagiri, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643217

name: Tea County Restaurant
signature_dish: Nilgiri tea with homemade banana cake
why_it_matters: Reviewers call it 'the only cozy place in town to enjoy a sip of tea or coffee' — a small cafe that gives Kotagiri the kind of warm tea-and-cake stop the bigger Nilgiri towns are full of. The banana cake is the standout.
insider_tip: This is the town's go-to for an afternoon tea break — order the banana cake with a pot of Nilgiri tea. Reasonable prices and a cosy room; good rest stop on the Ooty-Kotagiri route.
signature_address: Tea County Restaurant, Kotagiri, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643217

name: Silvertip Cafe
signature_dish: Lemon ginger tea with tea cake and brownie
why_it_matters: A family-run cafe on the Mettupalayam-Kotagiri Highway with 20+ varieties of tea and coffee plus house bakes — a popular refresh stop on the climb up to Kotagiri. Strong, consistent reviews for its baked delights.
insider_tip: It's a highway cafe, ideal as a planned stop on the Mettupalayam-Kotagiri climb rather than an in-town meal. Pair the lemon-ginger tea with the tea cake or brownie. Also runs a homestay above the cafe.
signature_address: Silvertip Cafe, Mettupalayam-Kotagiri Highway, Kotagiri, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643217

name: Kongu Mess Kotagiri
why_it_matters: A casual Kongunadu mess in Kotagiri town serving the meat-forward cooking of the Kongu belt — biryani, chicken kuzhambu and fried fish. One of the handful of dependable everyday eateries in a small town with thin dining options.
insider_tip: A working-day mess — go at lunch for the freshest biryani and meals. Plain and inexpensive; pair it with Tea County for an afternoon tea afterwards.
signature_address: Kongu Mess Kotagiri, Kotagiri, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643217

name: Orange Pekoe
area: Outskirts of Kotagiri, on the Ooty route
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals at a roadside stop on the Kotagiri-Ooty route
why_it_matters: A long-standing multi-cuisine restaurant on the outskirts of Kotagiri on the road toward Ooty — one of the few proper sit-down options outside the town centre, useful as a meal stop for travellers crossing the Nilgiri plateau.
insider_tip: Reviews are mixed — manage expectations and stick to the simple South Indian meals rather than the elaborate dishes. Its value is mainly as a convenient stop on the Kotagiri-Ooty drive.
signature_address: Orange Pekoe, Ooty Road, outskirts of Kotagiri, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643217
